name: omni-agent-skills
description: Tool-neutral registry of AI-assisted engineering skills and governance assets

skills.summary: Evaluates AI agent responses, tool invocation schemas, prompt regression suites, and model outputs against reproducible test cases.
Transforms documentation, codebases, and technical knowledge bases into structured, high-relevance Q&A pair datasets (llms-qa.json) for semantic search and retrieval.
Executes minimal, focused code modifications strictly adhering to approved architecture plans, propagating callsite updates and preserving existing behavioral contracts.
Audits git diffs and code modifications for code smells, DRY violations, adherence to repository conventions, and architectural consistency.
Simplifies over-engineered code, removes dead abstractions and redundant dependencies, flattens nested conditionals into early returns, and preserves exact behavioral contracts.
Authors and executes unit, integration, and property-based verification test suites using Pytest and unittest to empirically catch regressions and validate invariants.
Manages Semantic Versioning lifecycle, validates release metadata, updates changelogs, and orchestrates GitHub release workflows.
Analyzes system requirements, evaluates codebase dependencies, formulates architecture specifications, and scopes atomic implementation tasks.
Designs, implements, and executes multi-tier verification suites including unit, integration, golden snapshot regression, and property-based invariant testing.
Architects software repositories and products for direct AI agent integration, tool exposure via protocols (MCP, OpenAPI), and structured discoverability.
Manages open-source pre-launch auditing, namespace availability verification, community governance documentation, and release readiness checklists.
Audits workspace edits and staged files for exposed API keys, private tokens, passwords, and sensitive environment variables to prevent accidental credential commits.
Conducts objective technical competitive analysis, architectural positioning evaluations, trade-off matrices, and "Why Not X?" documentation.
Audits web applications for accessibility compliance (WCAG 2.1), responsive layout behavior, semantic markup, and Core Web Vitals performance.
Structures web applications and documentation for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), RAG search indexing, and machine-readable context discovery.
